newsitem.title: USA: Designer Holdings buys Calvin Klein stores.
newsitem.headline: Designer Holdings buys Calvin Klein stores.

text.p: Designer Holdings Ltd said Tuesday that it acquired 14 out of the 15 Calvin Klein outlet stores in the U.S., as well as rights to open additional outlets in the U.S., Canada and Mexico.
In a release Tuesday, the company said it expects the deal to be "neutral to moderately accretive to earnings in 1996 and to make a greater contribution to earnings beginning in fiscal 1997."

Under the agreement terms, Designer Holdings will assume existing leases of the Calvin Klein outlets and purchase inventory for about $4 million and certain fixed assets for about half a million dollars.
The company also said it will pay a royalty rate of seven percent on net sales.
The 14 outlets had revenues of about $32 million for the year ended December 31, 1995.
